name: Unwip 0.43.35
body:
Getting started:
- Picking "Distraction-free" in the welcome setup now actually opens the page in Writer mode, instead of just mentioning it.
- The "Pick a look" step says what it changes: colours everywhere, and the font and paragraph style for new books and the example. Books you already have keep their own look.
- The tour closes properly if you go back to all your books part-way through, instead of leaving its highlight on the main screen.
